    noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.bddCorrEndBimodOfLeftRep {H : Type u} {K0 : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [NormedAddCommGroup K0] [InnerProductSpace ℂ K0] [CompleteSpace K0] (rho : End H →⋆ₐ[ℂ] End K0) :
    CorrEndBimod H H

    If the target Hilbert space K0 already carries a genuine representation of End H, then Bdd H K0 is an End H-End H correspondence: left action is postcomposition by rho a; right action is the committed precomposition by (End H)^mop.
